name: family-travel-editor
description: AI-assisted travel video editing in DaVinci Resolve: organize footage, plan family films, draft voiceover and apply timecoded feedback.

interface.longDescription: Plan and revise family travel films with an AI assistant and DaVinci Resolve. Organize chosen camera and drone footage, reconstruct trip context, plan scenes, draft personal voiceover and apply timecoded feedback. The skill provides a repeatable local editing workflow, project templates, footage cataloguing and export measurement. Requires local file access; native editing requires your own Resolve installation. XML helpers create only same-rate, video-only straight cuts at 24, 25 or 30 fps. Live Resolve import remains unvalidated. Additional analysis tools and sharing services are optional and are not installed or invoked by this package. No automatic finished-film promise. Independent project, not affiliated with Blackmagic Design.
defaultPrompt: Help me edit my travel footage into a family film in DaVinci Resolve, starting with one scene.
Draft a personal travel voiceover from my confirmed memories and scene plan.
Apply my timecoded review comments to a new version of my DaVinci Resolve timeline.
